body.p: One morning, the son of the Old Woman of the EastThe "Old Woman of the East" is a spirit dwelling at the east end of the sky. She sends the dreadful east wind, which allegedly brings death. said to his mother, "Mother, you seem to be in a good temper today, I will go out without clothes." "Don't go," said the mother, "my temper is short, but the day is long. I do not yet know what kind of mood I will be in. Put on some clothes!" "No," said her son, "you look as if you are in good spirits today," and went off without clothing. In the evening, after sundown, a frost settled, and the son froze to death. The mother was upset that her son had not taken any clothes with him.
